forOrganisations.title: Give your programme a behavioural lens
forOrganisations.body: Entrepreneurship support programmes, incubators, and migrant and diaspora entrepreneurship initiatives use Ignio to understand founders' behavioural capabilities and design support around real needs — not assumptions.

segments.programmes: Entrepreneurship support programmes: track founder capability development across a cohort.
segments.incubators: Incubators and accelerators: build a behavioural baseline into your intake process.
segments.diaspora: Migrant and diaspora entrepreneurship initiatives: understand participants' starting points in a new economic ecosystem.
segments.economicIntegration: Workforce and economic-integration programmes: design targeted support for founders navigating a new country.

comparison.title: This isn't a personality test.
comparison.intro: Personality tests describe who you are. Ignio measures what you do — and what you can develop.
comparison.closing: Ignio doesn't just describe who you are — it helps you understand what you can develop.

fieldToTech.title: Built from practice, not assumption
fieldToTech.body1: For four years, our team worked directly with migrant entrepreneurs in London and kept seeing the same behavioural patterns: confidence under uncertainty, resilience through setbacks, hesitation to lead without a formal title.
fieldToTech.body2: We built a structured assessment to name and measure them properly — and that assessment became Ignio.
